Name: Topology integrity
Metric: ElectromagneticTransformer present | old PrimaryEnergyCoupling removed | ET connection ports L=3 R=6 | secondary 1/2/3 -> MeasLV=1 | W3A/W3B/W3C -> EnergyConverter=1 | PhaseA_W1W2W3 W3 enabled | PhaseB_W1W2W3 W3 enabled | PhaseC_W1W2W3 W3 enabled | EnergyConverter AC ports connected=1
Details: Checks W1/W2/W3 visibility, old proxy removal, and EnergyConverter AC connection.

Name: Nominal active operation
Details: Active voltage and Vdc regulators enabled at nominal grid voltage.

Name: Converter-zero passive fallback
Details: This checks whether zero converter commands behave like a conventional transformer. A fail means a physical bypass switch is still needed.

Name: Sag/swell voltage regulation
Details: Tutorial gate: LV RMS phase-voltage error below 5% for 0.9/1.0/1.1 pu grid voltage.

Name: DC-link voltage control
Metric: 9000Vgrid: Vdc 751.42 V 0.859 pu m_energy 0.218 | 10000Vgrid: Vdc 865.42 V 0.989 pu m_energy 0.021 | 11000Vgrid: Vdc 941.29 V 1.076 pu m_energy -0.119
Details: Tutorial gate: Vdc remains within 0.85-1.15 pu for the same voltage-regulation cases.

Name: Reactive power / PF control
Metric: No PF or Q reference loop in the tutorial controller yet.
Details: Requires adding an iq/Q/PF loop in EnergyConverter control.

Name: Three-phase unbalance compensation
Metric: RegulatingConverter currently uses one scalar m_reg for all phases.
Details: Requires per-phase or sequence-component voltage injection and unbalanced source/load cases.

Name: Harmonic mitigation
Metric: No harmonic current reference or PR/QPR/repetitive controller is present yet.
Details: Requires nonlinear load case and THD measurement before/after compensation.

Name: Fault ride-through smoke test
Metric: Balanced sag is covered by Test2; asymmetrical fault cases are not modeled yet.
Details: Requires configurable single/two/three-phase fault source and current-limit checks.

Name: Passive fallback with bypass
Metric: Zero-command behavior is measured in Test1B, but no physical bypass breaker exists.
Details: Requires adding a controllable bypass around the series injection path.
